description: Create a Kling task on RunAPI (motion control). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

background_source.description: Background source. Declared type: string. Known values: "video", "image".

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for async notifications. Declared type: string.

character_orientation.description: Character orientation. Declared type: string. Known values: "video", "image".

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

output_resolution.description: Output resolution. Declared type: string. Known values: "720p", "1080p".

reference_video_url.description: Reference motion video URL. Declared type: string.

source_image_url.description: Subject image URL. Declared type: string.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: motion_control
